mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary pressure indicated by CPIAUCSL crossing above 220 triggers a tightening monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such inflationary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicate a robust economic cycle, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are not positive in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high GDP growth (GDPC1 > 12000) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220), S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to peak valuation concerns.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day forward returns occur in regimes meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A dual signal of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 2%) and labor market tightening (UNRATE falling) creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year period, or returns are not positive in 80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in labor market employment (PAYEMS crossing above 140,000) signals strong job growth, boosting investor sentiment and resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such labor expansions are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in supply indicators (INDPRO < 110) suggests potential shortages or production constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are not negative in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle with rising FEDFUNDS rates and strong demand (HOUST > 1000), conflicting signals may suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day forward returns occur when the trigger condition is met, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year period.
